claims.statement: Preserves the registered KPI, denominator, population, window and decision rule rather than moving the goalposts.
Blocks unsupported causal winner and SCALE claims when experiment or measurement integrity is materially unresolved.
Separates unresolved causal attribution from operational decision sufficiency for bounded reversible actions, in both directions.
Treats sample sparsity as a precision problem bearing on the action, never as an identification failure lowering the causal claim.
Gives mature verified downstream economics precedence over an upstream acquisition proxy when they rank the arms in opposite directions.
Holds fixed-horizon discipline: an incomplete registered window right-censors the registered estimand and does not license an early call.
Identifies the comparison-level scope from the structure of the case rather than from its vocabulary, and aims comparison-level actions at it.
Returns exactly one valid instance of the closed output contract.

fixture_refs: Sealed externally authored pack, run 33304743788, artifact 9730260513
thresholds: Preregistered two-tier criterion, unchanged since stability-criterion-audit-2026-08-31.md
7 independent trials per fixture over 10 fixtures in 5 construct families; 70 trials total
Tier-2 contract-invalid output: at most 2 per fixture and 6 in total
Any INVALID trial voids the gate rather than passing or failing it
Zero retries; no best-of-N; every trial recorded
Held-out pack authored by a model family different from the candidate runtime, by an author with no access to the candidate and no field able to express an expectation

environment.model_or_executor: gemini-3.5-flash-lite via executor_gemini.py, temperature 0, thinking level medium
tools: Deterministic structural grading; no model judge
environment.state_contract: Each held-out fixture evaluates the exact frozen v1.2 assembly with case-supplied context. The executor receives one candidate-facing fixture at a time and never the expectations, the family or the oracle.
environment.authority_scope: Analysis and recommendation. Spend changes, campaign execution, commercial approval and legal interpretation remain external authority.

limitations: Qualification applies only to the exact artifact digest and the declared evaluation boundary.

Qualified on the Gemini candidate runtime family only. Cross-runtime portability is untested by this cycle and is a revalidation trigger, not an inherited PASS. The historical three-runtime protocol was formally revised before execution, not silently dropped; the revision record is release-closure-and-cross-model-revision-2026-09-02.md.
The held-out author is a language model on an independent family, not a human practitioner.
Structural output reliability sat at 1 tier-2 of 70 against a total cap of 6; the professional bar was met with zero margin by design, the structural bar with margin but not comfort.
This qualification does not lift or reinterpret the 1.1.0 quarantine, and it does not cover any Analytics specialization.

freshness.validity_boundary: Stable professional decision policies remain qualified while the exact core digest, the frozen criterion and the declared runtime assumptions are unchanged; volatile platform, legal and business facts require live verification at use time.
revalidation_triggers: Any behavior-relevant change to the artifact
Deployment or evaluation on a candidate runtime family other than Gemini
Any tier-1 professional-judgment failure observed in production use
Material runtime, provider or tooling change affecting qualified claims
Hidden coupling discovered during specialization or composition
